description: Probable cause of an alert on alerts/<device>/critical, used to suggest a team when no site rule routes it. Severity is not asked: it comes from the topic and site rules. State: {alert}, the alert's first line, at most 500 characters. Add a field only when the evaluation shows it helps, and never the device name: it acts as a prior. The threshold and the coverage gate are fitted to the generic evaluation file, where the model is often confidently wrong below 0.9; a site refits both on its own examples (p4n4 ai system1 eval --fit-thresholds).

cause.instructions: What is the most likely cause of the alert?

criteria.thermal: overheating, temperature above its limit, cooling failure
criteria.mechanical: vibration, wear, leak, crack, blockage, broken part
criteria.electrical: power loss, voltage, current, fuse, relay, motor drive
criteria.connectivity: device offline, timeouts, refused connections, network or broker down
criteria.sensor_fault: implausible, stuck or missing readings, low battery, calibration drift
criteria.process: setpoint, recipe, material or operator action
